reports.title: STERIS Announces Financial Results for Fiscal 2027 Second Quarter

guidance.heading: Fiscal 2027 Outlook
section: The Company is updating its prior outlook for revenue and earnings for fiscal 2027. Expectations for consolidated revenue growth are unchanged and include as reported revenue growth of 7-8% and constant currency organic revenue growth of 6-7%. Adjusted earnings per diluted share are now anticipated to be in the range of $11.35 to $11.55, an increase from prior expectations of $11.10 to $11.30. The revised outlook includes the benefit of approximately $0.18 from tariff refunds received year-to-date. All other elements of the most recently provided outlook remain unchanged.

desk.headline: Revenue up 9% to $1.59bn; adjusted EPS $2.94 beat $2.67 estimate; FY27 EPS outlook raised to $11.35-11.55
results: Revenue grew 9% to $1.59bn (8% organic at constant currency); adjusted EPS rose 19% to $2.94 and GAAP EPS to $2.19.
Tariff refunds added about $20m before tax this quarter, so part of the profit jump is one-off.
Life Sciences was the standout: revenue up 18% with capital equipment up 53%; Healthcare grew 9% and AST sterilisation services 5%.
A second restructuring plan, mainly in Healthcare, will cost about $45m and save about $9m a year.
First-half free cash flow dipped to $492.5m; the company spent $215.9m on buybacks and $128.4m on dividends.

guidance.summary: STERIS raised its fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS range to $11.35-11.55 (was $11.10-11.30), which includes about $0.18 from tariff refunds. Revenue growth outlook is unchanged at 7-8%; Life Sciences was raised and AST trimmed. The pending Xodus Medical deal is not yet included.

points: The CEO said Life Sciences strength gave confidence to raise that segment's full-year outlook and expects another record year.
Management said one Life Sciences order of over $10m helped the quarter and will not repeat every quarter.
No further material tariff refunds are expected; refunds received so far are built into the higher EPS range.
Customer destocking in AST is said to be over, with better volumes in September and October.
Management sounded more upbeat on hospital capital demand, though US procedure growth is now framed nearer 3%.
call.source: Press release (Exhibit 99.1); Earnings Whispers call summary via Finviz (5 Nov 2026)

watch: Underlying margins without tariff refunds, especially in Healthcare, where operating margin slipped
Whether AST growth picks up after destocking, given the lowered segment outlook
Closing of the Xodus Medical deal and the updated outlook that follows

sources.title: STERIS beats and raises but tariff refunds and one big Life Sciences order flatter a quarter with softer margins underneath — Earnings Whispers via Finviz, 5 Nov 2026
